public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] b = new int[5];
        int x, y = 0;
        x = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
            b[j] = scanner.nextInt();
            y += b[j];
        }
        System.out.println(y / x);
        scanner.close();
    }
